strategyReview: What is working: the Polymarket YES-overpricing edge continues to show up where it is measured correctly as contract premium decay — manual IV-touch rich NO (9/10 shadows, +5.86%/trade), XAU tail NO (8/11 shadows), weekend HL funding shadow book (188/253, +0.99%/trade), and live one-touch high-edge NO (4/4, +4.49%/trade). What is failing: the system is still burning tests on contract signals written as spot-direction bets, especially gold one-touch heatmap (35% win), broad one-touch NO shadows (47% win, negative net P&L), single-threshold funding reversion variants (37-48% win across MU/COIN/AAPL/CBRS), and HYPE-confirmed BTC momentum (36% win). Funding-extreme long live is also weak negative, while PM-proxy short clones like FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT and PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT are clearly failing in shadow.

failureClusters.evidence: The shadow-mined weekend funding long families for MU, COIN, AAPL, and CBRS are all around 37-48% wins, with many tests starting from funding already near 5.5% or showing continued downside before normalization. The single condition `asset_hl_funding_ann < -10` captures noisy, non-extreme or already-reverting observations instead of true tail exhaustion.
failureClusters.recommendation: Refine these variants to require a weekend window, a lower-tail percentile rather than a hard -10 threshold, and evidence that funding has already started turning higher before entry. Stop authoring raw single-threshold clones.

failureClusters.theme: HYPE confirmation as BTC continuation signal
failureClusters.evidence: The cross-asset IV/vol family is at 9/25 scorable tests (36% win). BTC was already near its 7-day high and above its 24h SMA when HYPE risk-on confirmation fired, so entries routinely arrived into late-stage FOMO or immediate pullbacks, not fresh continuation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not re-refine this family again. If the HYPE signal is ever revisited, it must be inverted into an exhaustion/fade mechanism or paired with a genuine momentum reset, not used as bullish confirmation after BTC is already extended.

failureClusters.theme: Contract signals diagnosed as spot-move predictions
failureClusters.evidence: Gold one-touch high-edge NO (H-534) has 35% scorable wins and 7 unscorable variants; examples show the correct P&L is contract premium behavior (NO prices ticking higher/terminal wins), while the spot-decline predictions failed. NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW has similar disease at 39% win.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as neutral contract premium fades with explicit contract P&L predictions, and gate on moderate edge bands, near-dated expiry, and tight spreads rather than spot move thresholds.

failureClusters.theme: Broad one-touch NO edge is too permissive
failureClusters.evidence: Shadow digest reports one-touch abs_edge<15 slice at 39.4% win and negative average P&L. Ranked findings show the edge concentrates in BTC/above-strike/moderate 3-8pt edge and near-dated mid-priced NO panels, while broad 1-3pt edge bands do not pay consistently.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep the live opening gate on the sharper edge buckets. Do not promote broad low-edge one-touch NO variants based solely on raw count; require edge bucket, direction, and expiry conditions that match the positive ranked findings.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS family sits at 14/30 scorable (47%) and the actual outcomes are funding-normalization grades, not the stated spot >2% move. The single `cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10` condition entered into continued funding deterioration or already-normalized readings, so it was a noisy timing trigger rather than capitulation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within two days and forces a >2% CBRS spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Cross-asset HYPE confirmation produced 36% wins. BTC was already above its 24h SMA and within 4% of its 7-day high when HYPE confirmed, so the setup repeatedly bought late-stage momentum instead of independent continuation. The HYPE signal is acting like a risk-on echo, not an independent edge.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO or overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-534 is 8/23 on scorable tests with 7 additional unscorable variants, and the examples show it was being judged on contract P&L while the primary prediction was a GOLD spot decline. The underlying-cap edge is a premium-richness signal on NO contracts; it does not forecast a 2% spot drop in 2 days.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL funding reversion is 11/23 with many losses showing funding stuck at 5.5% or drifting lower, not a sharp normalization. The static `aapl_hl_funding_ann < -10` condition does not isolate genuine funding capitulation or the turning point.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight focused on diagnosing the failing shadow-mined families. The recurring failure mode is category error: contract-premium signals are being tested as spot-direction bets, and static funding thresholds are being treated as timing triggers. Refined the weekend funding clones toward weekend + lower-tail + turn-higher conditions, and re-authored gold one-touch cap-edge as a neutral contract-premium fade. No parameter changes were made: weekendFundingEntryPct stays at -0.50 because the live weekend-clustered evidence is not significant, and the shadow weekend block only has 3 weekends, too few to justify a move. The YES-overpricing edge remains the best live edge, but it must continue to be measured on contract P&L, not spot direction.
